name: Sawtooth Wipe
description: A wipe whose edge is a row of sharp triangular teeth sweeps across the frame, or two toothed edges start interlocked and part from the middle like opening jaws. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: direction
params.description: Direction the toothed edge moves toward (with jaws, the axis along which the two edges part) (x right, y up)

params.name: teeth
params.description: Number of teeth along the edge

params.name: depth
params.description: Length of the teeth, relative to their width

params.name: jaws
params.description: Two toothed edges part from the middle instead of one sweeping across
